name: Kawakita Misuzu
source:
With a brother serving a harsh prison sentence, and his father a failed pharmaceutical owner, Misuzu is a journalist who thinks Kazuya has something to hide. She is an aggressive and direct individual, who acts more masculine than anything else. Looking for a scoop, Mizusu stalks Kazuya.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175338/www.elizar.com/?p=30]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
